title: Understanding Decision Trees
text: Decision trees create boundaries by splitting the feature space into rectangles. They use axis-aligned splits, meaning they can only create vertical or horizontal lines in the feature space.

title: Analyzing the Boundary
text: Look at the shape of the boundary in the image. Is it a straight line or a more complex shape? Decision trees can only create straight lines parallel to the axes.

hintAnswer: The boundary is circular or non-linear.

title: Decision Tree Limitations
text: Since decision trees can only create axis-aligned splits, they cannot form circular or complex boundaries. They are limited to creating rectangular regions.
